pageDescription: Access to public information of the National University of Concepción according to Law No. 5,282/2014.
heading: Access to Public Information
description: The National University of Concepción guarantees access to public information in compliance with Law No. 5,282/2014 on free citizen access.
fallbackParagraph1: Every person has the right to request and receive complete, truthful, adequate and timely information from any institution of the Paraguayan State, as established in Law No. 5,282/2014.
fallbackParagraph2: To exercise this right you can use the Unified Portal for Access to Public Information of the National Government, available at the following link.
ctaNote: You will be redirected to the official National Government portal.
